tests.backend_full_scope: Before final native-input and media QA refinements
tests.late_backend_scope: 87 passed plus release-gate regression 16 passed, overlapping scopes

motion.origin: actual owned QWidget snapshots + renderer rAF telemetry
motion.recording_semantics: Discrete native frames after six Qt drag gestures, each eight mouse moves at12ms; GIF timing reflects snapshot times. No continuous FPS claim.

performance.metric_semantics: Paint timings are actual WebEngine Canvas draw durations. Active frame intervals exclude gaps >=100 ms; their reciprocal is not whole-session FPS. Event-to-paint begins at JS pointer handler. IPC pauses are excluded from that latency.

whole-app-performance.method: Only image-verified Granger process trees; steady-state trials after warmup; no global GPU flags or system changes
whole-app-performance.memory_notes: RSS sums include shared pages; private commit is not private working set
whole-app-performance.cpu_notes: 100% one-core means one logical CPU; machine percentage also provided
